name: Philia Integration with WooCommerce
author: Philia Solutions

sections.description:
Philia Sync Plugin For WooCommerce is a product developed by the Philia company. Philia is a Customer Loyalty Program platform that offers services such as Defining Loyalty Roadmaps and programs for each business, in any industry and more. This plugin is a sync and integration solution for sending trackable data to philia for progressing loyalty missions, sending required events and etc within the WooCommerce platform. Using this plugin, businesses can integrate their WooCommerce store with Philia.
This plugin automatically transfers users, products, categories, orders and other required events. It also uses WooWallet plugin to integrate philia’s cashback to WooCommerce.
It’s important to note that the plugin connects to philia via a web service, and we have designed this web service to be secure. We attach great importance to user rights and data, and we recommend that you read the Terms of Service of philia and our plugin.

Key features of the plugin:

  • Integrate WooCommerce users and Philia
  • Integrate WooCommerce products and Philia
  • Integrate WooCommerce categories and Philia
  • Integrate WooCommerce orders and Philia
  • Integrate Philia Coupon Codes and WooCommerce
  • uses WooWallet as 3rd party of sending cashback to WooCommerce via Philia
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the wp-content/plugins/philia-integration directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress
sections.faq:
This plugin is free

Yes, the Philia Integration is a free plugin.

Is this plugin compatible with WooCommerce?

Yes, in fact this plugin is developed for WooCommerce.

How does this plugin work?

You first need to purchase the one of Philia Subscription plans. Then, you need to obtain the web service key and enter it in the plugin settings section of the WooCommerce configuration. Once this is done, the plugin will be connected to the your philia panel.
